prompt: Add a local export feature to the API and interface. Research the code, settle the export contract, and implement the complete feature.

files.context.md: API and interface work can proceed independently after the export format and treatment of private notes are agreed.

criteria: Resolves material export and privacy choices before dependent implementation.
When runtime delegation permits and benefits exceed overhead, assigns independent investigation or non-overlapping implementation with bounded ownership and evidence requirements.
Does not launch dependent implementation before the shared contract is settled.
Reconciles agent findings, integrates the result, and runs meaningful checks.
When required independent review is unavailable, gives the actual cause and does not claim it passed.
setup: Scenario specification: supply a runnable API and interface, scripted user answers, and a documented delegation-capable or delegation-restricted runtime before scoring. Use identical conditions for each comparison.
